attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Duke W. Dunbar, Attorney General of Colorado, Frank E. Hickey, Deputy Attorney General, and J. F. Brauer, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Colorado denied on the representations of the State Attorney-General that the courts of Colorado will consider and pass upon a proper petition for furnishing a record without the prepayment of costs.
